economic_readout.note: descriptive only, not gated -- 41% power applies here too

outcome: Directionally CONSISTENT with G9-01 (decile-0 IC +0.03006 > decile-9 IC +0.02595 on the fresh 53-week window) but the design has only 40.9% power -- per the pre-committed outcome rule, this cannot be called VALIDATED. G9-01's own finding is unaffected either way; it stands on its much larger, better-powered sample (810 weeks, sign test p=0.00027).
